description: An iPhone or iPad (Apple, USB vendor 05ac) in «Режим модема» over USB: the ipheth driver (kmod-usb-net-ipheth) on its vendor interface ff/fd/01 and a DHCP address from the phone, which routes and NATs itself. The phone shares only after it trusts the router: usbmuxd pairs it («Доверять этому компьютеру?» on the phone). A phone, not a modem: APN and SIM are set on the phone. Router mode is its only mode: no problem to report. The phone kind from another modem manager 3.5.x release notes (behaviour only); the interface class from the Linux ipheth driver
